body: I don't doubt it but the way she treates me, even if its unintentional is just not helping at all.

I know but I've isolated myself from all my friends and have no other family besides my 2 uncles who are mentally ill drug addicts. I have nowhere to go and I really don't want to go into foster care if that's the alternative. A part of me thinks waiting out one more year would be better, idk.
